integrity.arithmetic: exact mod-2 coefficient and symbolic polynomial computations
integrity.scope: full nonzero coefficient space and all rational points

scientific_limitations: Only geometrically smooth cubic surfaces defined by nonzero forms over F2 in fixed projective coordinates; no claim about higher fields, singular cubics or extension-field fibers.
Prior full projective classifications establish the 141/36 orbit counts; only the rational Gauss-fiber profile distribution is claimed as newly determined.
No independent external verification has been performed; a published associated atlas of older cubic-surface data was inaccessible for direct comparison.
title: Exact rational Gauss-fiber profiles of smooth cubic surfaces over the binary field
